name: Tracks Host
description: This Qualys host is that computing_core host: the machine Qualys tracks, as every source that sees it keys it. Drawn for an EC2 host, whose computing_core host is (aws-ec2, instance id), when the run read its software (req-qualys-installed-software). A reference, beside TRACKS_EC2_INSTANCE__qualys: the aws_core instance is the AWS record, the computing_core host is the machine other scanners share.
